newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stock market ends weaker, seen picking up.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stock market ends weaker, seen picking up.

text.p: Turnover plunged on the Croatian stock market on Friday and prices ended lower due to a lack of buyers after yesterday's bank holiday, but interest was expected to pick up slightly next week.
* Eight of 16 active stocks fell, five rose and three were flat.
* Volume shrank to 3,214 units from 18,843, turnover to 1.2 million kuna from 16.5 million on Wednesday.
* Food stock Podravka was the most active issue with 1,153 shares sold, ending one kuna lower at 304 kuna.
* Private Croatia Banka led gainers, adding five kuna or 3.7 percent to 140 kuna on volume of 245 shares.
* Top loser was hotelier Arenaturist, falling 19 kuna or 11.87 percent to 141 kuna with 48 units traded.
